comment: Parameters 136 to 143 hold the per-track loop lengths and 168 to 175 the MIDI mapping settings; none of them has a widget on the panel, so they are untagged. Probability Notch Width is a MenuLabel heading; the items under it are None  0%, Slim  20%, Mid  35% and Wide  50%. The five velocity sliders are labelled by their parameter names None, Step, Loop, Step  & Loop and Index. Factory MIDI mappings are module presets under Rack's own Preset submenu. The installed presets folder holds nine for IversonJr, covering the APC Mini, the Akai APC Key 25, the Launchpad Mk1 Mini, the Launchpad Pro Mk1, the Launchpad Mk2 and the Launchpad Mk3 Mini.
